span.p: 9. ARCHITECTURE DECISIONS

div.style: color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Why this approach?
1. Modular monolith instead of microservices: one local user and lower operational cost.
2. Clean/Hexagonal ports instead of direct SDK calls: replaceable adapters and testability.
3. One orchestrator instead of peer agents: fewer handoffs, lower cost, clearer debugging.
4. Redis pool + dependency injection instead of Singleton: durable shared state without hidden global state.
5. Deterministic services instead of LLM execution: security, limits, validation, and audit are reproducible.
6. Local-first instead of cloud-first: harden BigQuery-to-Desktop workflow before Fabric administration.
